subject: expression: add method `CanonicalHashCode` to `Expression` to decouple it with `stmtctx` (#48666)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent, scoped to the touched `expression`, `planner`, `sessionctx`, and `table` paths. The change is primarily an API refactor: `Expression.HashCode` no longer takes `stmtctx.StatementContext`, canonical hashing is now an explicit `Expression.CanonicalHashCode`, and `StatementContext.CanonicalHashCode` is removed with all callers updated (grouping-sets / rollup dedup and related planner lookups now call `CanonicalHashCode`). Canonicalization logic itself matches the prior implementation (previously guarded by the stmtctx flag), and I did not find any Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, session/transaction, or privilege/visibility regressions introduced by this commit.
